recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast vertical composition featuring two thick gold Cuban link chains draped against a solid black background, framed by the open lapels of a red jacket with ornate gold baroque patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right jacket lapels framing the central void
Contrast between the reflective metallic gold and the matte black negative space
Repetition of the interlocking chain link texture
Color harmony between the gold jewelry and the gold baroque fabric print
coreInvariants: Two distinct gold chains of varying lengths
Red textile with gold filigree patterns

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The gold chains are the central subject, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright gold chains provide the primary visual anchor against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the U-shape of the chains downward, then moves to the bottom-left corner to read the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the center provides breathing room and high contrast for the jewelry.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black serves as the foundation and negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red in the jacket provides a bold frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold appears in the chains and the jacket pattern for a luxury feel.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and high value in the gold highlights against a zero-value black background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeral 2 matches the height and weight of the uppercase letters

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the bottom edge of the jacket

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights and widths for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Clean, condensed, and modern uppercase aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of two thick gold Cuban link chains hanging vertically against a pitch-black background. On the left and right edges, include the open lapels of a red silk jacket featuring intricate gold baroque/filigree patterns. The lighting should be dramatic, highlighting the metallic sheen of the gold.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner. The top line should be significantly larger than the bottom line. Align both lines to the left edge.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly two chains visible?
Is the text in the bottom-left corner white and condensed?
Does the jacket have a red base with gold patterns?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the jacket
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold chains look heavy and metallic.
Check that the red jacket framing is symmetrical in placement.
Verify the text is legible and correctly aligned to the left.
Confirm the black background is deep and devoid of noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central jewelry + Symmetrical textile framing + High-contrast black background + Bottom-left condensed typography.
